text:
Roope Hintz is the quiet one on a Dallas forward group full of louder names, and he is quietly having a very efficient season. He has 21 points (8 goals) in 22 games on 16.5 minutes a night, which works out to 3.47 points per 60, above our talent range for him (2.43 to 3.37).

The skating is the tell. Hintz has 92 bursts over 20 mph by NHL Edge tracking, 99th percentile in the league, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him carrying the puck in on 63% of his entries last season, with 55% of his shots coming off the rush. Dallas controls 54% of the 5v5 expected goals with him on the ice.

Two things to keep an eye on. He is shooting 20.5% on just 39 shots, and is without a goal in his last four games while still picking up four assists. And Evolving-Hockey noted that his 2025-26 results ran ahead of his chances, even as it rated his defensive play in the 99th percentile. Our season range is 58 to 83 points, the middle at 69.
